name_note: Genomes that GTDB places in this genus are often labelled Olsenella in NCBI, the genus from which Paratractidigestivibacter faecalis was reclassified.

sentences.text: Paratractidigestivibacter is a bacterial genus proposed together with Parafannyhessea and Tractidigestivibacter in a study of strains isolated from various human specimens.
The same study reclassified Olsenella faecalis as Paratractidigestivibacter faecalis, after finding that the studied strains were closest to members of the paraphyletic genus Olsenella.

Paratractidigestivibacter faecalis was reclassified from Olsenella faecalis, a species described for a strictly anaerobic, Gram-stain-positive, short-rod-shaped strain isolated from the faeces of a healthy Korean.
In that description the major end product of the strain was lactic acid and its DNA G+C content was 65.5 mol percent.
